plugins.name: AiiDA results
plugins.summary: Open AiiDA nodes by PK or UUID: load("aiida:1234") for structures, trajectories, bands, workflows and aiida-phonopy results
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Reads the AiiDA profile you use with verdi (local SQLite or PostgreSQL; no daemon or RabbitMQ), or one on another machine over SSH (aiida://user@host/1234; nothing installed there). A WorkChain or WorkGraph PK opens its trajectory (restarts joined), phonons, bands or structures; aiida-phonopy results become phonon modes through ewald-phonopy (pip install 'ewald-aiida[phonopy]'). python -m ewald_aiida tree/find browses the provenance graph. Read-only. Phonons need ewald-phonopy >= 0.2.1. Needs an EWALD with reader schemes (after 2026-10-19).

plugins.name: phonopy force constants
plugins.summary: Phonon bands phonopy computes from phonopy.yaml with FORCE_SETS or force constants, and from phonopy.Phonopy objects
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: phonopy loads phonopy.yaml, phonopy_params.yaml or phonopy_disp.yaml with FORCE_SETS or FORCE_CONSTANTS and computes the band structure with eigenvectors along the seekpath path; from_phonopy turns a phonopy.Phonopy object (from aiida-phonopy, say) into a pipeline. Installs phonopy and seekpath. band.yaml, VASP IBRION=5-8 OUTCARs and the PhononMode animation are built into EWALD since 2026-10-23, and version 0.3 needs such an EWALD (use 0.2.2 with an older one).

plugins.name: Phosphor UI theme
plugins.summary: A green-on-black CRT terminal look for the desktop app: monospace text, square corners, bold icons
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Sets every kind of key a UI theme may: all color tokens (phosphor green accents, amber data, a near-black 3D view), JetBrains Mono for the UI and editors (bundled with EWALD, so it looks the same on Windows, macOS and Linux), square corners, comfortable spacing, bold icons and extra style sheet rules (dashed panel-header rules, a bar on the current cell). After installing, pick Phosphor under Preferences > General > UI theme.

plugins.name: PLUMED collective variables
plugins.summary: Collective variables from PLUMED over a trajectory, COLVAR files and metadynamics free energy surfaces
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Plumed runs a plumed.dat over the trajectory through PLUMED's MD-engine interface (values match plumed driver); LoadColvar aligns an existing COLVAR with the frames; FreeEnergySurface sums a HILLS file as plumed sum_hills does. Adds the Claude tools compute_plumed_cvs and read_plumed_output. Plumed needs the PLUMED library and its Python binding (conda install -c conda-forge plumed py-plumed); the rest works without. Was part of EWALD before 2026-10-19.

plugins.name: sim-agent results
plugins.summary: Open your finished sim-agent calculations by AiiDA PK: load("simagent:1234") for trajectories, structures and VASP files
plugins.author: frssp
plugins.description: Reads a sim-agent server's results API v1 with an access key made in its web UI (the key is kept in the OS keychain). A workflow opens as steps with their trajectories, structures and retrieved files; CHGCAR/LOCPOT and other files left on the cluster are read over SSH. Adds a sim-agent side bar (each calculation with the name of the chat that submitted it), the workflow AI tools and a Diagnose button (also `python -m ewald_simagent doctor`) that checks the connection step by step; a band-offset workflow opens with its potential lineup (VBM, CBM, E_F, Schottky barrier) and a work-function workflow with the work function of every slab, as notebook cells. Read-only: submitting stays in sim-agent. Needs a sim-agent with the results API and an EWALD with workflow sources (after 2026-10-20).
